item.title: Lawrence Park Dinor listed for sale

item.title: New attractions on the way as Waldameer preps for upcoming season
item.description: Waldameer Park is undergoing off-season construction to debut a new Water World expansion for the upcoming summer season. The park is also preparing for the return of the fan favorite Paratrooper ride following a one-year hiatus. The expansion at Water World features a tower with two five-person family rafts and a new endless river attraction. [...]

item.title: Millcreek School Board votes to switch healthcare provider for employees
item.description: Millcreek School District employees are getting new health insurance following a vote by the school board Monday evening. In a 7-2 vote, the board voted to switch their employee coverage from Highmark to Meritain Aetna.
